svg.title: Seasonal frosted vinyl — A · Bazaar — Curry District signage concept
svg.desc: Etched-look privacy film at seated eye level, swapped by season: marigold toran for festival season, kulhads and star anise for chai season.
svg.text: Etched-look film at seated eye level: diners feel tucked in, the street still sees the glow.
Swap the film per season (≈ 1–2 wks lead, S). Window-coverage limits may apply — check with the City/landlord.
